findings_qualitative.value: No significant asymmetry or disturbance in the SZE image within current errors; ICM consistent with being isobaric

evidence.quote: We find no significant asymmetry or disturbance in the SZE image within the current measurement errors.
This suggests that the ICM in this region is consistent with being isobaric.

findings_qualitative.value: Inner pressure profile steeper than distant clusters and matches local cool-core clusters

evidence.loc: 4.3 Compton y-parameter map and the inner pressure profile
evidence.quote: and is clearly steeper than that from more distant counterparts by (cite: Planck13) and (cite: McDonald14b)

findings_qualitative.value: Gas density in agreement with Abell 2029 and Abell 1795 at r > 0.2 r500 but systematically higher at smaller radii

evidence.quote: whereas it is systematically higher at smaller radii

findings_qualitative.value: Entropy profile better matches the steady-state cooling flow slope K ~ r^1.4 than K ~ r^1.2

evidence.quote: The observed entropy profile shows a better agreement with $K\propto r^{1.4}$ than $K\propto r^{1.2}$

claims.hypothesis: Is the Phoenix cluster core disturbed or asymmetric in the SZE?
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 3 12-m + 7-m SZE image, quadrant radial profiles and residual map after subtracting the mean over an X-ray-defined ellipse
claims.result: SZE detected at >11 sigma; quadrant profiles consistent within errors and no significant disturbance in the residual image
claims.finding: No significant asymmetry or disturbance in the SZE image within the current errors

evidence.quote: We find no significant asymmetry or disturbance in the SZE image within the current measurement errors.

claims.hypothesis: Does the inner SZE pressure profile of the Phoenix cluster look like other distant clusters or local cool-core clusters?
claims.experiment: Compton y map reconstructed from the missing-flux-corrected ALMA image and azimuthal average compared with generalized NFW pressure profiles
claims.result: Profile agrees with Arnaud et al. local cool-core clusters and is steeper than Planck13 and McDonald14b profiles
claims.finding: Central concentration is much higher than in other distant clusters and agrees with the local cool-core pressure profile

evidence.quote: The detected SZE signal shows much higher central concentration than other distant galaxy clusters and agrees well with the average pressure profile of local cool-core clusters.

claims.hypothesis: Can SZE plus X-ray imaging measure the central gas temperature while minimising AGN and X-ray absorption contamination?
claims.experiment: Non-parametric deprojection combining ALMA SZE and Chandra 0.7-2.0 keV images, compared with X-ray-only deprojection with and without intrinsic absorption
claims.result: SZE+X-ray temperature at r < 27 kpc is 2.70 +/- 1.71 keV and 3.01 +/- 1.86 keV with and without absorption, whereas X-ray-only changes from 2.73 to 6.37 keV
claims.finding: The method is insensitive to intrinsic absorption

evidence.quote: Our method can minimize contamination by the central AGN and the X-ray absorbing gas within the cluster, both of which largely affect the X-ray spectrum.

claims.hypothesis: Does the gas temperature drop strongly toward the center of the Phoenix cluster?
claims.experiment: Deprojected temperature profile compared with mean profiles of local and distant cool-core clusters
claims.result: Central temperature ~5 times lower than the ~16 keV at r > 300 kpc; entropy <10 keV cm^2 and cooling time ~0.1 Gyr at r < 27 kpc
claims.finding: Gas temperature drops by at least a factor of 5 toward the center, larger than in other clusters, supporting efficient radiative cooling

evidence.quote: Unlike typical clusters at any redshift, gas temperature drops by at least a factor of 5 toward the center.

claims.hypothesis: How much gas is cooling efficiently in the Phoenix cluster?
claims.experiment: Mass of ~3 keV gas within r = 27 kpc from the deprojected profiles
claims.result: Mcool = (6.4 +/- 0.9)e11 Msun, ~20% of the central galaxy stellar mass
claims.finding: The gas is cooling efficiently and nearly isobarically down to the inner ~20 h^-1 kpc

evidence.quote: We identify $\sim 6 \times 10^{11} M_\odot$ cool gas with temperature $\sim 3$ keV in the inner $20 ~h^{-1}$ kpc.
Taken together, our results imply that the gas is indeed cooling efficiently and nearly isobarically down to this radius in the Phoenix cluster.

why_this_data.value: X-ray analysis is hampered by a bright AGN and absorbing gas, so an independent SZE probe is needed

evidence.quote: A major challenge in the X-ray analysis of this cluster is the presence of a bright AGN and possibly cold neutral gas in the central galaxy
It is hence crucial to explore the physical states of the gas by other independent methods.

why_this_method.value: SZE plus X-ray deprojection is insensitive to X-ray absorbing gas and the central AGN

evidence.quote: Our method can minimize contamination by the central AGN and the X-ray absorbing gas within the cluster, both of which largely affect the X-ray spectrum.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: C2 as a point source instead of elliptical Gaussian gives a flux about 25% lower; C3 and W also checked with Gaussian models with little change

evidence.quote: For comparison, if source C2 is modeled by a point source, the fitted flux is lower by about 25%

We checked that the results in table [\[tab-source\]](#tab-source) are essentially unchanged when these sources are modeled by a Gaussian varying its full width at half maximum (FWHM) as a free parameter.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Intrinsic absorption neglected in X-ray fits gives much higher central temperature

evidence.quote: intrinsic absorption largely modifies the spectral shape at 0.7–2.0 keV and leads to a reduction of the best-fit temperature by more than a factor of 3
While the limit is still weak, the observed perturbations in the Phoenix cluster core is consistent with being isobaric

limitations_admitted.value: Absolute values of the X-ray pseudo pressure are arbitrary

evidence.quote: Note that absolute values of the pseudo pressure are arbitrary

limitations_admitted.value: Temperature at r > 250 kpc cannot be constrained by the ALMA data

evidence.quote: As the temperature at $r > 250$ kpc ($\theta > 37''$) cannot be constrained by the ALMA data

limitations_admitted.value: X-ray-only deprojection includes statistical errors only

evidence.quote: For simplicity, only statistical errors were taken into account in this particular analysis.

referee_caveats_inferred: Deprojected central temperature has a large uncertainty (2.70 +/- 1.71 keV), so the factor-of-5 drop is only weakly constrained by the SZE alone
Spherical symmetry assumed in the deprojection despite X-ray cavities and N-S asymmetries in the core
Missing-flux correction rests on simulations that use an X-ray pseudo pressure map as input, with an assumed ypeak normalisation
Cool gas mass depends on the h = 0.7 choice and adopted mass deposition rates from other papers
